# Version 4.156.0
> **Skia m156 and GTK4 rendering** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews Skia m156 and adds GPU rendering for GTK4 applications. Linux NoDependencies packages regain system-font discovery without fontconfig. GTK4 gains a GL-backed canvas and high-density raster backing, while WebAssembly assets align with .NET 11. Review the GTK4 coordinate change and Tizen requirements before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **GTK4 raster painting defaults to physical pixels** — On high-density displays, SKDrawingArea now exposes physical-pixel CanvasSize and paint Info. Set IgnorePixelScaling to true to retain logical painting coordinates while keeping full-resolution backing. RawInfo remains physical and GTK input coordinates remain logical. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Tizen packages require Tizen 10** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp native packages now target net10.0-tizen10.0 and support x64 and arm64; Tizen 8/9 are no longer supported. Retarget applications to Tizen 10 and .NET 10. Native source builds require the Tizen 10 SDK and GCC 14.2. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))

## Engine

- **Skia m156** — Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 156 without adding managed APIs or native entry points. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.100; its native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.4.0. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247))

## API Surface

- **Native GTK4 GPU canvas** — Adds SKGLArea with PaintSurface, CanvasSize, GRContext, an opt-in render loop and IgnorePixelScaling. GTK owns the GL context; manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy. Both GTK4 views support logical painting over physical-pixel backing. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux fonts without fontconfig** — Restores directory-backed system-font discovery in SkiaSharp.NativeAssets.Linux.NoDependencies, using /usr/share/fonts/ by default. Family lookup and SKShaper construction can use installed fonts again without adding a fontconfig dependency. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))
- **GTK4 raster resource handling** — Disposes the Skia surface before its Cairo-owned pixel storage and marks pixels dirty after color-channel conversion, correcting the backing-buffer lifecycle. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Platform

- **WebAssembly assets for .NET 11** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp select Emscripten 6.0.2 archives for net11 and later, including threading and SIMD variants. net8 retains 3.1.34 and net9/net10 retain 3.1.56. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306))

## Security

- **Consistent Windows native hardening** — Aligns Windows native builds with their matching v143 Spectre CRT libraries and propagates CFG and stack-cookie flags through ANGLE's compiler defaults. CRT provenance does not imply whole-program Spectre mitigation. ([#5238](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5238))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100 selects Emscripten 6.0.2 assets for .NET 11 and later, raises Tizen support to Tizen 10, and aligns Windows builds with matching Spectre CRT libraries. The native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.4.0.

## Preview 1 (October 12, 2026)
